```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>Before SVG.</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert('svg-xss')</script><text>SVG text</text></svg><p>After SVG.</p>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});
```
